Proposition
[General evolution of the minimizing Harnack tensor] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0317 ↗ thm:chow-ii-minimizing-harnack-two-tensor-evolution 1. ch15:15.27\group Minimizing Harnack Tensor

Without assuming $Z\ge 0$, \[ \begin{aligned} (\nabla _t-\Delta )Z_{ab}={}& 2S_{mntu}K_{avut}K_{bvmn}-\frac2tZ_{ab} +2R_{cabd}Z_{cd}-2P_{acd}P_{bdc}\\ & +2R_{acbd}S_{ijk\ell }P_{ijc}P_{k\ell d} -4S_{ijk\ell }R_{idae}P_{k\ell b}P_{dje}\\ & -4S_{ijk\ell }R_{idbe}P_{k\ell a}P_{dje} +4R_{iepf}R_{jeqf}S_{ijk\ell }P_{k\ell a}S_{pqmn}P_{mnb}. \end{aligned} \]
Proof

\sketch Repeat the differentiation of $M-S(P,P)$ in the preceding theorem without using a sum-of-squares decomposition of $Q$. Completing only the derivative terms gives $2S(K,K)$; direct contraction of all remaining curvature and $P$-terms gives the displayed six algebraic terms.

□
